One of the world's most extensive private collections of vintage Masters Tournament badges, tickets, and memorabilia — spanning from the founding 1934 Augusta National Invitation through every champion of the modern era. Assembled over twenty-five years by collector Marcus Burnell.

Badge No. 1109 —
The 1934 Masters

The centerpiece of the collection: an original badge from the inaugural Augusta National Invitation Tournament, the event that would become The Masters. Signed by Bobby Jones, Clifford Roberts, and Horton Smith (the tournament's first champion) — one of only two known dual-signed specimens.

Sold at auction in April 2024, setting a world record for any golf ticket ever sold. Now on private display at The Azalea House.

The Complete Archive

Every Badge,
Every Year.

A chronological record of Augusta — from the founding invitations of the 1930s to the champions of the present day. Each piece available for private acquisition.

I.

The Founding Era

1934 · 1949  —  Sixteen Years
The inaugural decade of the tournament that would define a sport — and the invitations, badges, and programs that witnessed it.
II.

The Golden Age

1950 · 1969  —  Twenty Years
The era of Hogan, Palmer, Nicklaus, and Player — when Augusta rose to become the most revered stage in golf.
III.

The Modern Era

1970 · 1999  —  Thirty Years
From Ballesteros to Tiger's debut — three decades of evolution, international dominance, and legendary finishes.
IV.

The Contemporary Era

2000 · 2024  —  Twenty-Five Years
Tiger's reign, the rise of the new generation, and the most recent chapters of Masters history.
